- scope: src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicService.java, src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicServiceImpl.java, src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/UserService.java, src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/UserServiceImpl.java, src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/ApplicationSwaggerConfig.java

- rationale: Dependency-order.md requires service layer after repositories. Service layer contains REDESIGN classes per architecture-profile §7. ClinicService facade removed per §7.2, with business logic subsumed by individual resource endpoints. Services converted to thread-safe CDI beans.
- kind: reimplement
